manifests.inst-pymolt-eval.sh:
cd /work
export DISABLE_BCOLZ_AVX2=1 MAKEFLAGS=-j1
pip install -q --only-binary :all: -r lock-slim-pymolt-eval.txt pytest 2>&1 | tail -3
# per-package fallback: build sdists one at a time
while read l; do [ -z "$l" ] && continue; pip install -q --no-deps "$l" 2>&1 | tail -1; done < lock-slim-pymolt-eval.txt
pip install -q pytest
pip list | wc -l
